# testdata/settle1e

Synthetic fixtures for the SETTLE-1e acceptance (dist/test/settle1e.sh): values without code or
single characters, whole-word matching and the referenced entries' layout. The dry-run and
layout checks reuse testdata/settle1d's crew and budget conversations. Every person, place, host,
path and date here is invented. `@YEAR@`, `@AS_OF@`, `@CREW@`, `@BUDGET@` and `@BUDGET_ID@` are
filled in by the test.
